name: Eker
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Eker is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah through the lineage of Ram. He is the son of Ram (not the same Ram who was Amminadab's father) and brother to Maaz and Jamin. He is primarily known from genealogical records and has no further narrative role in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Eker is mentioned as a son of Ram in the genealogy of Judah's descendants through the Jerahmeel line.

keyEvents.title: Eker's Brothers Are Mentioned
keyEvents.description: Along with Eker, his brothers Maaz and Jamin are mentioned as sons of Ram, son of Jerahmeel.

keyEvents.title: Jerahmeel's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Eker belongs to the lineage of Jerahmeel, who was the firstborn son of Hezron, an important branch of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of the history of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: As part of the genealogy of Judah, Eker helps document the extensive branching of Israel's largest tribe, which later became associated with the kingdom.
